evaluator: claude-opus-4-7 / general-purpose VLM subagent (1 per figure)

verdict.summary: The generated figure reproduces the two-panel structure, dual-axis layout, log-contrast x-axis, sigmoidal CRFs, and percent-modulation dashed curve, with correct panel titles and legends. But it has major qualitative failures: no inset schematics in either panel; in Panel A the attended and ignored curves do NOT converge at high contrast (they diverge); Panel A modulation does not drop near zero; and Panels A and B look essentially identical, so the figure fails to demonstrate the contrast-gain vs response-gain distinction that is its entire point.
